layout.spacing: Generous padding for thumb reachability (p-4 to p-6). Compact lists (gap-2) to fit more upgrades.

animation.particle_burst: absolute w-4 h-4 bg-secondary-main rounded-full blur-[2px] animate-[ping_0.5s_cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1)_forwards]

icons.style: Sharp, technical, glowing accents. Use colors to differentiate states.

Login.elements: Game Logo (large uppercase typography), 'Sign in with Google' button (glassmorphism style with G icon), Terms links.

MainGame.layout: Top HUD for currencies/level. Center massive tappable orb/character. Bottom sheet/tabs for upgrades.
MainGame.elements: Ki Energy/sec counter, Total Energy, Tappable Orb, Floating +1 damage text on tap, upgrade shortcuts.

Upgrades.layout: Scrollable list inside a bottom sheet or dedicated tab.
Upgrades.elements: Building rows (Icon, Name, Level, Next Cost, CPS boost, Buy Button). Highlight affordable upgrades.

Profile.layout: Top heavy avatar showcase, stats grid below.
Profile.elements: Anime Avatar (large, glowing border), Power Level badge, Achievements bento grid.

Leaderboard.elements: Podium for Top 1-3, dense list for 4-100, current player rank pinned at bottom.

tappable_orb.description: Main tappable character/orb for the idle game. Use in center of MainGame screen.

training_dojo.description: Icon/Image for Training Dojo upgrade building.

spirit_generator.description: Icon/Image for Spirit Bomb Generator upgrade building.

crystal_mine.description: Icon/Image for Ki Crystal Mine upgrade building.

anime_avatar.description: Player avatar image used in Profile and Leaderboard screens.

game_background.description: Main sci-fi anime landscape background for Login and Main Game screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use a Mobile-First layout constrained to typical mobile dimensions (max-w-md mx-auto relative overflow-hidden for desktop rendering), using a full-screen view (h-screen w-full).
Implement particle effects on the tap action for the orb. You can use standard React state or framer-motion to create floating text (+1).
Avoid using Shadcn 'Card' for the main layout; instead build custom sci-fi panels using raw div with glowing borders.
Ensure 'Inter' is NOT used for headings. Use Outfit or Space Grotesk via Tailwind classes or standard imports. If importing fonts, add the Google Fonts link in index.html.
Ensure the bottom navigation uses a glassmorphism effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background-surfaceGlass).
Use the provided image URLs for the avatar, orb, buildings, and backgrounds.
Add testIDs (e.g., data-testid='game-tappable-orb') to all interactive elements.
